Error.BAD_REQUEST: The character data couldn't be read. Try again, or discard the draft and start over.
Error.SCHEMA_TOO_NEW: This draft was saved by a newer version of Character Creator. Ask your GM to update the module.
Error.WORLD_MISMATCH: This draft belongs to a different world.
Error.RULES_MISMATCH: This draft was started under different rules than this world uses. Discard it and start again.
Error.GM_OFFLINE: A GM must be online for this.
Error.NOT_ACTIVE_GM: Only the active GM can do this.
Error.CHARACTER_LIMIT: You already have as many characters as your GM allows.
Error.ALREADY_SUBMITTED: This character has already been submitted.
Error.SPECIES_NOT_ALLOWED: That species isn't available in this game. Choose another.
Error.CLASS_NOT_ALLOWED: That class isn't available in this game. Choose another.
Error.BACKGROUND_NOT_ALLOWED: That background isn't available in this game. Choose another.
Error.ABILITY_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Your GM doesn't allow that way of setting ability scores.
Error.POINT_BUY_INVALID: Point buy scores must be 8–15 and use exactly 27 points.
Error.STANDARD_ARRAY_INVALID: Use each standard array score (15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8) exactly once.
Error.ROLL_INVALID: The ability scores don't match your recorded roll.
Error.UNKNOWN_ITEM: Part of your character refers to something that no longer exists. Review your choices.
Error.UNKNOWN_ADVANCEMENT: One of your choices no longer matches the compendium. Review your choices.
Error.UNKNOWN_ADVANCEMENT_TYPE: One of these options uses a feature Character Creator doesn't support yet. Ask your GM.
Error.NOT_ALLOWED: One of your choices isn't one of the allowed options.
Error.TOO_MANY_PICKS: You picked more options than allowed.
Error.UNFULFILLED: A required choice hasn't been made.
Error.ASI_OVER_LIMIT: Those ability score increases exceed what's allowed.
Error.ASI_LOCKED: That ability can't be increased by this option.
Error.NOT_OFFERED: One of your choices isn't offered here.
Error.APPLY_FAILED: One of your choices couldn't be applied. Review your choices.
Error.UNKNOWN_ENTRY_TYPE: Your starting equipment uses an option Character Creator doesn't support yet. Ask your GM.
Error.MISSING_CHOICE: Choose one of the equipment options.
Error.WRONG_PICK_COUNT: Pick the number of items this equipment option asks for.
Error.NOT_IN_CATEGORY: That item doesn't belong to the required category.
Error.NOT_PROFICIENT: You need proficiency to take that item.
Error.UNEXPECTED_SELECTION: Your equipment choices don't match the options. Review your equipment.
Error.BAD_MODE: Choose between the starting equipment and starting wealth.
Error.WEALTH_OUT_OF_RANGE: That starting wealth is outside what the roll can give.
Error.WEALTH_ROLL_INVALID: Your starting gold doesn't match your recorded roll.
Error.NOT_A_CASTER: This character can't learn spells at level 1.
Error.CANTRIP_COUNT: Choose the number of cantrips your class allows.
Error.SPELL_COUNT: Choose the number of spells your class allows.
Error.SPELLBOOK_COUNT: Choose the number of spells your spellbook starts with.

Error.WRONG_LEVEL: That spell's level isn't available to you yet.
Error.DUPLICATE: The same spell was chosen twice.

Error.BAD_IMAGE: That image couldn't be used. Try a different file.
Error.WRONG_IMAGE_TYPE: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
Error.UNREADABLE_IMAGE: That file couldn't be read as an image.

restrictions.Name: Allowed content
restrictions.Hint: Which compendium packs and entries players may choose from. Edited in Character Creator's settings.

abilityMethods.Name: Ability score methods
abilityMethods.Hint: The ways players may set ability scores. With only one, it is chosen automatically.

characterLimit.Name: Characters per player
characterLimit.Hint: How many characters each player may create with Character Creator. 0 means no limit.

folderName.Name: Folder for new characters
folderName.Hint: New characters go into this Actors folder, created if missing. Leave empty for no folder.

showOnLogin.Name: Offer character creation on login
showOnLogin.Hint: Show "Create a character" to players who don't have one when they log in.

allowPortraitUploads.Name: Allow portrait uploads
allowPortraitUploads.Hint: Let players upload a portrait for their character. The GM's browser saves it.

maxUploadMB.Name: Largest portrait file (MB)
maxUploadMB.Hint: The largest image a player may choose, before it is resized to 1024 px.

ringColors.Name: Default token ring colors
ringColors.Hint: Used when a player doesn't choose ring colors. Unset means the player's user color.

species.Title: Species
species.Hint: Choose your species. Its traits, speed and size come with it.

class.Title: Class
class.Hint: Choose your class. It sets your hit points, proficiencies and level-1 features.

background.Title: Background
background.Hint: Choose your background. It adds skills, tools and starting equipment.

abilities.Title: Ability scores
abilities.Hint: Set your six ability scores with a method your GM allows.

choices.Title: Choices
choices.Hint: Make the choices your species, background and class offer at level 1.

equipment.Title: Equipment
equipment.Hint: Take your starting equipment, or the starting wealth where it's offered.

spells.Title: Spells
spells.Hint: Choose your cantrips and level-1 spells.

details.Title: Details
details.Hint: Name your character and add the details you want.

portrait.Title: Portrait
portrait.Hint: Upload a portrait, or skip it and add one later.

review.Title: Review
review.Hint: Check everything, then create your character.

Abilities.OnlyOne: Your GM allows only this way of setting ability scores.
Abilities.ChooseMethod: Choose how you want to set your scores.
Abilities.PointBuyHint: Spend 27 points. Each score starts at 8 and can go up to 15; the higher ones cost more.
Abilities.RollHint: Rolling posts the dice to chat for everyone to see. You can only roll once — to roll again you'd have to start over.
Abilities.IncreasesNote: Your species or background adds to these; the totals are on the right of each row.

Start.Heading: Create your character
Start.Lead: This takes you through your species, class, background, ability scores and the choices they offer. Your GM decides which options you can use.
Start.Note: Your draft saves itself as you go, so you can close this and come back later.

Options.Choose: Choose an option on the left.
Options.AutoSelected: Your GM allows only this one, so it's already chosen.
Options.SubclassHint: This class chooses its subclass at level 1.
Options.ArtIcon: The compendium's icon for this option

Choices.None: Nothing to choose here yet — pick your species, class and background first.
Choices.AutomaticHint: There was only one option, so this was chosen for you.
Choices.GrantHint: These come with your choice. Anything optional is yours to take or leave.
Choices.NoWidget: This choice isn't something the wizard can show yet.
Choices.RebuildNote: Every change rebuilds your character, so these numbers are always what your GM will create.

Equipment.RollHint: The roll is posted to chat. You can only roll once.

Spells.cantripsHint: Cantrips you can cast at will.
Spells.spellbookHint: The level-1 spells written in your spellbook.
Spells.spellsHint: The spells you have ready to cast. You can change these after a long rest.
